name: evolvable-software
description: Assess how ready a product is to evolve itself safely, and how much of that AI drives.

interface.longDescription: EVOLVE assesses how ready a software product is to evolve itself safely: to take requests through to release, fix the issues users face and find adjacent opportunities, increasingly with AI doing the work. It reports an autonomy level for each loop, how much of it AI drives, the critical controls that fail, exactly what blocks the next level and a fix-first plan, with every score tied to file-level evidence.
defaultPrompt: Assess how ready this repository is to evolve itself safely
What blocks this product from the next autonomy level?
How much of this product's change loop does AI drive?
